start: Settings, a member moving from Hevy with a Hevy export file on the phone

steps.action: Open Settings, Your data, tap 'Bring in from Hevy or Strong'
user_sees: Title 'Bring in from Hevy or Strong'
'Bring in your workouts from another app'
'Which app are you moving from?' with 'Hevy' ('Your workout file, or a link to a shared routine.') and 'Strong'
'Your file is read on your phone. Nothing is uploaded.'
Title 'Import from Hevy' with the export steps
Button 'Choose Hevy file'
must_not: The Strong steps shown for Hevy

user_sees: 'Reading...' then a preview: 'Workouts', 'Sets', 'Exercises', 'Date range' with years
must_not: Rows dropped without a 'Rows left out' line

user_sees: 'Workouts added', 'Sets logged', 'New exercises created'
Buttons 'Bring my routines in' and 'Done'
must_not: A workout already here added again

start: Bring in from Hevy or Strong, a member moving from Strong

steps.action: Tap 'Strong', then 'Choose Strong file' and pick the Strong .csv
user_sees: Title 'Import from Strong'
For an older file: '<exercise> <weight> — kg or lb?' with 'Kilograms and km' and 'Pounds and miles', none chosen
must_not: kg or lb chosen for the member

steps.action: Answer kg or lb, tap 'Merge', then 'Bring my routines in'
user_sees: Routines built from the file
must_not: Routines in the wrong order or missing sets

start: Import from Hevy, a member with a shared Hevy routine link

steps.action: Tap 'Paste a Hevy link' under 'Have a Hevy routine link?'
user_sees: A box for the link with how to copy it in Hevy
must_not: A link to Strong asked for here

steps.action: Paste the link and read it
user_sees: The routines exactly as saved: sets, rep ranges and rest
If part of a folder failed: 'Only 4 of 6 routines could be read — try again' with 'Try again' or 'Use these'
must_not: Half the folder brought in without a word

start: Android share menu, a member shares a Hevy file to MettleUp

steps.action: Share the file from Files to MettleUp
user_sees: The import screen opens straight on the preview
must_not: The file read as the wrong app

steps.action: Pick a file that is not a Hevy or Strong export
user_sees: A plain line that the file is neither

steps.action: Pick a Hevy file with no workouts
user_sees: 'No workouts were found in that file.'
must_not: An empty import shown as done

steps.action: Pick the same file again after importing it
user_sees: 'All <n> workouts are already here'

start: Import from Hevy, a member with workouts already on the phone

user_sees: 'Delete <n> workouts first?' and button 'Replace'
'<n> workouts replaced', then 'Undoing...' and the old workouts back
must_not: The imported workouts left after the undo
'Couldn't undo the import...' with no way to try again

start: Import on a phone with the sample member's demo data

user_sees: 'Demo removed, history imported'
must_not: The demo workouts mixed into the member's history
